exercises.name: Barbell bench press
cues: Feet flat, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with a slight pause.
Press up and slightly back, elbows about 45 degrees.

exercises.name: Incline barbell bench press
cues: Set the bench to 30 degrees, feet flat and braced.
Lower the bar to the upper chest under control.
Drive the bar up and slightly back, elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Start with the dumbbells over your upper chest, palms forward.
Lower until your elbows sit just below the bench.
Press up and slightly in without banging the dumbbells.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
cues: Set the handles level with the middle of your chest.
Press until your arms are nearly straight, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable fly
cues: Set the pulleys at chest height and step forward.
Bring your hands together with a soft bend in the elbows.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

exercises.name: Push-up
cues: Hands under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower until your chest is a fist from the floor.
Push back up without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Lie flat with the dumbbells stacked over your chest.
Lower with elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.
Press up and slightly in until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
cues: Grip the bar just inside shoulder width.
Keep your elbows tucked and lower to the lower chest.
Press up hard, locking out with the triceps.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
cues: Stand tall, bar resting on the front of your shoulders.
Brace your core and press straight up past your face.
Finish with the bar over your mid-foot, elbows locked.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Sit with your back against the pad, dumbbells at ear height.
Press up until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
cues: Set the seat so the handles start level with your ears.
Press up smoothly and stop just short of locking out.

exercises.name: Arnold press
cues: Start with palms facing you at shoulder height.
Rotate your palms outward as you press overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly on the way down.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall with a slight bend in the knees.
Pull the handle to your belly, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let your arms reach forward.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
cues: Rest your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully stretched.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
cues: Brace one hand on the bench, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower with control and do all reps before switching sides.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
cues: Stand facing the cable with arms straight, slight forward lean.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs with straight arms.
Let it rise slowly until you feel your lats stretch.

exercises.name: Inverted row
cues: Hang under a bar with your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest to the bar, elbows back.
Lower slowly without letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: Barbell row
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows back.
Lower under control without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
cues: Start each rep from the floor with your torso parallel.
Pull the bar hard to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor and reset between reps.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip slightly wider than your shoulders, chest up.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
cues: Set the assistance so you can manage the full rep range.
Pull your chin over the bar with your chest up.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pull-up
cues: Hang with straight arms, shoulders pulled down.
Drive your elbows down to bring your chin over the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
cues: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with a slight elbow bend.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height, leading with elbows.
Lower slowly and keep your traps relaxed.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Set the pulley low and stand side-on to it.
Raise the handle out to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Machine lateral raise
cues: Set the pads just above your elbows.
Lift your arms out to the side until level with shoulders.
Lower slowly and keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: Upright row
cues: Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull up to chest height, elbows leading and staying wide.
Lower slowly and stop if your shoulders pinch.

exercises.name: Cable pushdown
cues: Pin your elbows to your sides, chest up.
Push down until your arms are straight, then squeeze.
Let the handle rise only to chest height.

exercises.name: Overhead cable extension
cues: Face away from the cable with the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms forward until they are straight.
Return slowly, keeping your elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Assisted dip
cues: Set the assistance so you can manage the full rep range.
Lower until your elbows reach 90 degrees, torso upright.
Press up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
cues: Lie back with the bar held over your forehead.
Lower the bar behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Extend hard until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead extension
cues: Hold the dumbbells overhead with elbows close to your head.
Lower behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps.
Extend back up and squeeze your triceps.

exercises.name: Triceps kickback
cues: Hinge forward with your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Straighten your arm behind you and pause for a second.
Bend back to 90 degrees without dropping your elbow.

exercises.name: Cable curl
cues: Stand tall with elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar to your shoulders and squeeze.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
cues: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing in.
Curl to your shoulders without swinging your body.
Lower slowly and keep your palms facing in.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl up and turn your palms towards the ceiling.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

exercises.name: EZ bar curl
cues: Grip the angled parts of the bar, elbows at your sides.
Curl to shoulder height without leaning back.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
cues: Set the bench to 45 degrees and let your arms hang.
Curl without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower slowly to feel the stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
cues: Sit and rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell to your shoulder and squeeze.
Lower slowly and do all reps before switching arms.

exercises.name: Face pull
cues: Set the rope at face height and step back.
Pull towards your face, elbows high and wide.
Finish with your hands beside your ears, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse fly machine
cues: Set the handles in front of you at shoulder height.
Sweep your arms back with a soft bend in the elbows.
Return slowly without letting the weights slam.

exercises.name: Rear delt row
cues: Hinge forward with the dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.
Row with your elbows flared wide, hands in line with elbows.
Lower slowly and keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: Back squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width, toes out slightly.
Brace and sit down between your hips, knees tracking your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot, chest up.

exercises.name: Front squat
cues: Rest the bar on your front shoulders, elbows high.
Sit straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up with your elbows staying high.

exercises.name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder width on the middle of the platform.
Lower until your knees reach 90 degrees, back flat on the pad.
Press through your whole foot without locking your knees.

exercises.name: Hack squat
cues: Shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your heels without locking out.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest.
Sit down between your hips, elbows inside your knees.
Stand up tall and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Stand tall with the bar against your thighs, knees soft.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings are tight, then stand up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Push your hips back, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the middle of the bar, feet hip width.
Grip the handles, chest up, and push the floor away.
Lock out tall, then lower with your hips back.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
cues: Bar over your mid-foot, shins close to the bar.
Pull the slack out, brace and push the floor away.
Keep the bar close and lock out tall.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
cues: Take a wide stance with toes pointed out.
Grip inside your knees, chest up, hips close to the bar.
Spread the floor with your feet and stand tall.

exercises.name: Good morning
cues: Bar on your upper back, feet hip width, knees soft.
Push your hips back and hinge until your torso is near parallel.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Rear foot on the bench, front foot a stride ahead.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through your front heel.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
cues: Step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your foot.
Push off the front foot into the next step.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back and lower your rear knee towards the floor.
Keep your front shin upright and chest tall.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
cues: Step wide to one side and sit into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.

exercises.name: Leg extension
cues: Set the pad just above your ankles, knees in line with the pivot.
Extend until your legs are straight and pause briefly.
Lower slowly without letting the weight drop.

exercises.name: Step-up
cues: Place your whole foot on a knee-high box.
Drive through that foot to stand up tall on the box.
Lower slowly with control, then repeat on the same side.

exercises.name: Wall sit
cues: Back flat against the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles and hold.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
cues: Set the pad just above your heels, hips pressed down.
Curl until the pad touches your glutes.
Lower slowly without lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
cues: Set the thigh pad snug and the ankle pad above your heels.
Curl down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly, resisting the weight the whole way.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
cues: Kneel with your ankles anchored and body upright.
Lower forward as slowly as you can, hips straight.
Push back up with your hands if you need to.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, bar across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your shins are vertical.
Squeeze at the top with your chin tucked.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
cues: Face away from the low pulley, rope between your legs.
Push your hips back and let the rope pull you down.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Glute kickback
cues: Attach the cuff to your ankle and hold the frame.
Kick back and up, squeezing the glute at the top.
Return slowly and finish all reps before switching legs.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat.
Drive your hips up and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
cues: Stand on the edge with your heels hanging off.
Rise as high as you can and pause.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
cues: Stand on one foot on a step, holding on for balance.
Rise onto your toes and pause at the top.
Lower slowly below the step to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
cues: Set the pad snug on your lower thighs.
Push through the balls of your feet to lift the pad.
Lower slowly until your calves are fully stretched.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
cues: Place your toes on the bottom edge of the platform.
Push the platform away with your toes, legs straight.
Let your heels drop back slowly for a stretch.

exercises.name: Plank
cues: Elbows under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your ribs down.
Breathe steadily and hold without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back with arms up and knees over hips.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
cues: Kneel facing the cable with the rope beside your head.
Crunch down by rounding your spine, elbows to your knees.
Return slowly and keep your hips still.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
cues: Hang from the bar with your shoulders pulled down.
Lift your knees towards your chest, curling your hips up.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Pallof press
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, handle at chest height.
Press your arms straight out in front and hold.
Resist the pull, keeping your hips and shoulders square.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
cues: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll out slowly as far as you can control.
Pull back with your abs, not your hips.

exercises.name: Side plank
cues: Elbow under your shoulder, feet stacked or staggered.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides for the next set.

exercises.name: Bird dog
cues: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Reach one arm and the opposite leg out long.
Pause, then return slowly without twisting your hips.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
cues: Start in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch.
Keep your hips low and your pace steady.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
cues: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Bring one elbow to the opposite knee as you extend the other leg.
Move slowly and keep your lower back on the floor.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
cues: Stand tall with a heavy dumbbell in each hand.
Walk with short quick steps and shoulders pulled back.
Keep your ribs down and grip tight.

exercises.name: Russian twist
cues: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Rotate your torso side to side with control.
Keep your chest up and move from your ribs.

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
cues: Set the pulley high and stand side-on.
Pull the handle down and across your body to your opposite hip.
Rotate through your hips and return slowly.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
cues: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor.
Press your lower back down and hold.

exercises.name: Treadmill
cues: Stand tall, look ahead and let your arms swing naturally.
Land softly under your hips with short quick steps.
Ease the speed up gradually rather than all at once.

exercises.name: Stationary bike
cues: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal smoothly at a steady cadence, shoulders relaxed.
Push and pull through the whole pedal stroke.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
cues: Push with your legs first, then swing your back, then pull.
Return in reverse: arms, then body, then legs.
Keep the stroke rate steady and the handle level.

exercises.name: Dynamic warm-up (upper)
cues: Arm circles, 10 each way.
Band pull-aparts, 15.
Scapular push-ups, 10.

exercises.name: Dynamic warm-up (lower)
cues: Leg swings, 10 each leg.
Bodyweight squats, 15.
Walking lunges with a twist, 10 each side.

exercises.name: Cool-down (upper)
cues: Doorway chest stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Cross-body shoulder stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Overhead triceps stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Lat stretch on the rack, 30 seconds each side.

exercises.name: Cool-down (lower)
cues: Standing quad stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Seated hamstring stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Figure-four glute stretch, 30 seconds each side.
Wall calf stretch, 30 seconds each side.

exercises.name: Mobility flow
cues: Cat-cow, 10 slow reps.
World's greatest stretch, 5 each side.
90/90 hip switches, 10 each side.
Thoracic rotations on all fours, 8 each side.
